summary: 31-year-old female snowmobiler broke her leg below the Top of the World lookout in Washington Gulch after going off a blind drop, falling six to eight feet and landing on top of the sled; ~10 Crested Butte SAR members reached her at 2:24 p.m., packaged her on a Cascade toboggan then an enclosed toboggan for about a mile, and transferred her to an ambulance at 4:02 p.m. for transport to Gunnison Valley Hospital
location: Washington Gulch, below Top of the World lookout
notes: Date = the Saturday before the December 14, 2016 article (weekday-verified); ~8 companion snowmobilers dug out the sled and a patient platform; paramedic and nurse on scene
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Gunnison County, Colorado, United States)
